BiblicalUsage: Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite, for there was peace between Jabin and the house of Heber. Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said, turn in, my lord, turn in to me, fear not.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jael is the most startling deliverer in Judges: a woman in a tent, a peg and a hammer, and the captain of Canaan's army dead at her feet, and the song of Deborah blesses her above women in the tent.
